instance.description: Campaign Naval Defend Area Encounter setup (default tuning values)

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Don't convert if allow target following.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Terminate the encounter when all squads in the scan radius around the Encounter target are destroyed (at final target, i.e. the "EngageTarget" stage).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Terminate the encounter when all squads in the scan radius around the Encounter target are destroyed (for "EngageEnemyEnRoute" stage).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Terminate the encounter when all buildings in the scan radius around the Encounter Target are destroyed (at final target, i.e the "EngageTarget" stage).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Terminate the encounter when all buildings in the scan radius around the Encounter Target are destroyed (for "EngageEnemyEnRoute" stage).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: If "ai_phase_encounter_clear_enemy_squads" or "ai_phase_encounter_clear_enemy_buildings" are set, then setting this to true will also include squads or buildings who cannot be pathed to or attacked for other reasons. Setting this to true may cause your encounter to get stuck so be careful...

enum.name: key
enum.comment: terminate if final target destroyed

enum.name: key
enum.comment: After Encounter squads arrive at the target location, they will wait for combat at the location ("DefendDestination" stage).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: If True, the Encounter will check for nearby Encounters to merge with (while in "TravelToTarget" stage).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Whether the encounter should attack the final target (if the final target is a squad or SGroup).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Combat area around the Encounter target (for all stages except "TravelToTarget").

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Maximum leash distance from the Encounter target that squads can stray to engage in combat or defend allies (at final target, i.e. the "EngageTarget" stage).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Maximum leash distance from the Encounter target that squads can stray to engage in combat or defend allies (for "EngageEnemyEnRoute" stage).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Scan range from the centre of the Encounter squads to look for enemies in meters, used in conjunction with below combat fitness check (for "EngageEnemyEnRoute" stage). Set to 0 to disable (don't scan).

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Minimum percentage of squads required to arrive at "FormUp" location before moving on to the next "TravelToTarget" phase. 1.0 implies all squads must arrive.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Maximum wait time (in seconds) for squads to "FormUp" before moving onto the next "TravelToTarget" phase.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Combat fitness threshold from the perspective of the enemy team. Set to value between 1 (enemy wins) and 0 (enemy loses) to determine at what ratio the encounter should terminate. Set to -1 disable. Set to 0 for attack anyone we meet.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Encounter will end with "Fallback" reason when combat fitness ratio of enemy versus us is above this threshold.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Health threshold for an individual squad member to decide it wants to fallback. Used in conjunction with "ai_phase_encounter_fallback_squad_health_percent".

enum.name: key
enum.comment: What percentage of all encounter squads are wanting to fallback before the Encounter to end with "Fallback" reason.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Encounter will end with "Fallback" reason when remaining squad count (comparing to squad count at start) falls below this percentage threshold.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Combat area and maximum leash distance around Encounter target, for "TravelToTarget" stage only.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Minimum percentage of squads required at FINAL destination before encounter terminates successfully with "At Destination" end reason. 1.0 implies all squads must arrive.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: The amount of time to remain idle after the phase encounter is completed.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: This is the combat radius at the destination area. Encounter squads will engage these targets and then continue moving to the destination until within the arrival radius (i.e. the "ai_phase_encounter_destination_area").

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Minimum percentage of squads required at ENROUTE destination before encounter terminates successfully with "At Destination" end reason. 1.0 implies all squads must arrive.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: tuning for AI archer kiting behaviour on how often they reposition themselves to back away from enemies (in seconds). Use 0 to disable reposition.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: The encounter siege attackers will ingore any wall openings further than this radius that are on the same wall sections they are attacking.

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Building types to ignore when Encounter checks Exit Conditions on "building all cleared" or "combat fitness threshold".

enum.name: key
enum.comment: Building types to ignore when Encounter checks Exit Conditions on "building all cleared" or "combat fitness threshold".

enum.name: key
enum.comment: "ai\ai_formation_coordinator" AE blueprint, containing combat related tunings (for "EngageTarget", "EngageEnemyEnRoute" stages)
